correcao_desta_versao.defeito_1_teto_desalinhado: v1 judged (O) of E with the ceiling that includes products (FABDEM/GEDTM30); Lnb and C used only v23xmlp. This script judges all THREE arms with the ceiling of the two networks (same label family). The ceiling with products remains descriptive (O_teto_produtos), not deleted.
correcao_desta_versao.defeito_2_fallback_sem_base: v1 had a generic else that returned NAO_SE_SUSTENTA when no literal condition matched (this happened in 20-30m, where (O) IMPROVES in both decisive arms). This script compares each criterion by ORDINAL RANKING (improvement != worsening, asymmetric rule of the design) and, if still no literal condition of the design matches, returns SEM_VEREDITO_LITERAL_NO_DESENHO instead of inventing NAO_SE_SUSTENTA.
